name.description: 1 to 63 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit. With a preset, it defaults to the preset's name.

path_allowlist.description: The rules a request must match, as METHOD /path. A custom upstream needs at least one; * /** allows everything.

port.description: A custom upstream defaults to 443 with TLS and 80 without.

preset.description: The preset to copy. Absent to build a custom upstream from the settings.

profile.description: openai, anthropic or generic. A custom upstream defaults to generic.

server_name.description: The TLS server name, when it is not the host.

tls.description: A custom upstream defaults to true.

last_used_at.description: When the token last authenticated a request, to the minute. Absent if never.

name.description: The token's name, which is the actor of every change made with it.

revoked_at.description: When the token was revoked. Absent while it is live.

actor.description: Who made the change: an admin token's name, or system:<what> for kman itself.

after.description: The target after the change, where the action records it. Never a secret.

before.description: The target before the change, where the action records it. Never a secret.

id.description: Rising with each entry; the cursor for paging.

more.description: Whether the log holds more entries beyond this page: after it, or before it with latest.

basic_username.description: For the basic style, the username. When absent, a credential's secret is the whole user:password.

header.description: For the header style, the template: Name: value {key}.

secret.description: The new real secret, made at the provider after the leaked one was revoked there. kman seals it and never shows it again.

rotated_keys.description: Every virtual key on the credential that was not revoked, oldest first, with its new secret, shown only this once. Each is an app that needs its new key.

name.description: 1 to 63 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit. A revoked token's name stays taken.

credential.description: The credential's name or id. Needed when the upstream has more than one.

name.description: An optional label: 1 to 63 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit, unique among keys not revoked.

note.description: Free text of at most 1024 bytes, with no control characters.

policy.description: The key's policy, a JSON object. Defaults to the empty policy.

tags.description: At most 32 labels of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' and '-'.

ttl_seconds.description: How long the key stays valid from now, at most the maximum key lifetime. Defaults to the default key TTL.

secret.description: The token itself (kma_...). kman keeps only its hash, so it is shown only this once.

sdk_base_path.description: Appended to kman's proxy URL to make an SDK's base URL.

sdk_env.description: The variable an SDK for its upstream reads the key from.

secret.description: The virtual key itself (kmn_...). kman keeps only its hash, so it is shown only this once.

last4.description: The end of the secret, to tell credentials apart. Absent for a secret too short to show any of.

rotated_at.description: When the secret was last replaced.

secret.description: A new secret, which overwrites the old one. The credential keeps its id, so virtual keys on it are not touched.

keys_checked.description: How many keys were looked at: the keys that work now. A disabled, revoked or expired key cannot be abused, and a canary is meant to be left alone.

fix.description: The kman command that fixes it, ready to run. An open key's has a placeholder to replace with the network the key is used from.

last_used_at.description: For unused: the start of the last hour in which the key forwarded a request. Absent if it never has.

credential.description: The credential's name. Absent once a revoked key's credential is deleted.

expired.description: Whether its expiry has passed, whatever its status.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working. Every key has one: there is no never.

id.description: The key id: the non-secret handle inside the key, and how this API addresses it.

name.description: An optional label, unique among keys not revoked.

policy.description: The key's policy, a JSON object: empty until it is edited.

policy_version.description: The version of the policy format the policy is in.

spend.description: What the key has spent today and this month, beside its caps. Shown when the key is read, and not in the audit log.

upstream.description: The upstream's name. Absent once a revoked key's upstream is deleted.

name.description: A new name, or empty for none.

note.description: A new note, or empty for none.

policy.description: The new policy, a JSON object, which replaces the old one.

tags.description: The new tags, which replace the old ones.

ttl_seconds.description: A new expiry, this long from now. It may not be later than the key's creation plus the maximum key lifetime, unless that shortens the key's life.

secret.description: The real secret. kman seals it and never shows it again. For basic auth without a username, the whole user:password.

notice.description: What to tell the operator when it is stale.

stale.description: Whether the table is past 60 days old.

models.description: The built-in entries. An override below may hide one.

overrides.description: The price overrides, which win over the built-in entries until removed.

audio_output_micro.description: Audio output. Absent: billed at the output price.

cache_write_micro.description: Cache writes. Absent: billed at the input price.

cached_micro.description: Cached input. Absent: billed at the input price.

long_context.description: Prices for a whole request whose input is over a size.

max_output.description: The most tokens one response can output, which sizes reservations.

mode.description: chat, responses, completion, embedding or realtime.

per_minute_micro.description: Voice: per minute, billed per second.

preset.description: The preset this entry belongs to. Absent for a global entry, which every upstream falls back to.

reviewed.description: Whether a person checked max_output against the provider's docs.

service_tiers.description: The service tiers with their own prices.

audio_cached_micro.description: Cached audio input. Absent: billed at the audio input price.

audio_output_micro.description: Audio output. Absent: billed at the output price.

max_output.description: The most tokens one response can output, which sizes reservations.

upstream.description: The upstream it applies to, by name. Absent for an install-wide override.

changed.description: How many it added or changed, each with its own audit entry.

overrides.description: Every override it named, as it now stands.

unchanged.description: How many already had these prices.

audio_cached_micro.description: Cached audio input. Absent: billed at the audio input price.

audio_output_micro.description: Audio output. Absent: billed at the output price.

cache_write_1h_micro.description: One-hour cache writes. Absent: billed at the cache write price.

cached_micro.description: Cached input. Absent: billed at the input price.

input_micro.description: Input, in microdollars per million tokens.

output_micro.description: Output, in microdollars per million tokens.

grace_seconds.description: How long the old secret keeps working beside the new one, at most 30 days. Absent or 0 ends it at once, on the next request.

key.description: The same key, with the same id, spend, policy and history: only its secret is new.

previous_valid_until.description: When the old secret stops working. Absent when it stopped at once.

sdk_env.description: The variable an SDK for its upstream reads the key from.

secret.description: The new virtual key (kmn_...). kman keeps only its hash, so it is shown only this once.

default_key_ttl_seconds.description: How long a new virtual key stays valid unless told otherwise. At most the maximum key lifetime. Default 90 days.

max_key_lifetime_seconds.description: The longest any virtual key may stay valid. No key is created or extended past it. Default 365 days.

soft_budget_defaults.description: The percentages of each spend cap that warn when crossed, rising, for keys that set none. Default 50, 80, 100.

spend_timezone.description: The IANA time zone in which daily and monthly spend periods start at 00:00. Default UTC. A change takes effect when kman restarts.

cap_micro.description: The key's cap for the period, in microdollars. Absent for none.

cost_micro.description: What has been charged, in microdollars, estimated_micro included.

estimated_micro.description: The part of cost_micro charged as an estimate: the whole reservation, for a response that was cut off or reported no usage.

period.description: The day, such as 2026-11-11, or the month, such as 2026-11.

reserved_micro.description: Held for requests in flight. A cap counts it as it counts cost_micro.

unmetered_requests.description: Requests forwarded that could not be metered, whose cost is unknown and so is not in cost_micro.

credentials.description: Its credentials, by name. Never a secret.

path_allowlist.description: The rules a request must match, as METHOD /path: * is any method or one segment, and a last segment of ** is the rest of the path.

preset.description: The preset it was copied from. Absent for a custom upstream.

to_version.description: The version of the preset this kman holds.

up_to_date.description: Whether this kman holds no newer version, so there is nothing to sync.
